description: This PHP source file defines the PerformanceReviewAPI class within the OrangeHRM project. It provides REST API endpoints for managing performance reviews, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting reviews. The class leverages various traits for service access, validation, and date handling, and uses OpenAPI annotations for documentation. It is a central API controller for performance review operations specific to the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewAPI
classes.description: API controller class providing endpoints for CRUD operations on performance reviews within the OrangeHRM HRM system. Implements methods for listing, creating, reading, updating, and deleting performance reviews with validation, service interaction, and OpenAPI documentation.
